requirement_text.ISS-0329: test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs:140 sets realm = "jit-disabled-test-realm", a hardcoded literal, and inserts a tenant carrying it via insert_tenant_for_realm!/1. tenants.idp_realm_id has a unique partial index (tenants_idp_realm_id_partial_index), so when a concurrently-running partition -- or a leftover row from an earlier aborted run -- already holds that realm id, the insert fails with Ecto.InvalidChangesetError: 'idp_realm_id has already been taken'. The fix already exists in the same file. The other two tests use a unique_realm/1 helper (lines 154 and 167); line 140 is the lone holdout. Same class as WF03-ISS0059-20260819 (commit 8870068, 'collision-proof tenant slug suffix across 30 test files'), which fixed slugs but left this realm id behind. The test_parallel.sh exit-code sub-finding has been RETRACTED as a misread (see docs/issues/ISS-0329.yaml).

task.description:
Execute WF-03 Steps 0.5 and 1 for ISS-0329.

STEP 0.5 — Registry lookup:
1. Search docs/issues/*.yaml for resolved entries with symptoms matching a hardcoded realm id or idp_realm_id collision in test files.
2. Note whether WF03-ISS0059-20260819 (slug collision fix, commit 8870068) constitutes a prior similar fix whose fix pattern should be reused.
3. Document in result.

STEP 1 — Diagnose root cause:
1. Read test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs in full, especially lines 130-180.
2. Read lib/letflow/oidc/jit_provisioning_config.ex (especially for_realm/1 and default/1).
3. Read config/test.exs lines around 113-140 (oidc_jit_provisioning config).
4. Identify exactly WHY line 140's hardcoded realm causes a cross-partition collision AND why a naive swap to unique_realm/1 is NOT sufficient (the unique realm won't be in config/test.exs's oidc_jit_provisioning map, so JitProvisioningConfig.for_realm/1 falls back to default/1 which returns enabled: true -- the 403 assertion would then fail).
5. Specify the complete fix needed: (a) use unique_realm/1 for the realm, AND (b) dynamically add the unique realm to the :oidc_jit_provisioning Application config with enabled: false, cleaning up via on_exit. Show the exact application config mutation pattern (similar to what setup/0 already does for :oidc's token_verifier).
6. Verify: grep test/ for any other hardcoded idp_realm_id values that are inserted into tenants (besides 'jit-disabled-test-realm' and 'bpm-default').
7. Confirm the test_parallel.sh exit-code sub-finding is retracted (see docs/issues/ISS-0329.yaml) -- no code change needed for test_parallel.sh.

Do NOT implement the fix. Complete handoff with next_action: 'Route to CODE-DESIGNER for fix design'.
